projects.summary: Explainable ICP fit + time-decayed engagement -> tier/action; FastAPI, CSV CLI, n8n workflow; 33 tests.

SPF budget, DMARC (DMARCbis DNS Tree Walk discovery, psd tag, tree-walk and PSL org domains, t testing flag, np, invalid-p -> p=none fallback), RFC 8058 headers, DKIM keys, DKIM-Signature header check, content lint, complaint guardrail, preflight() aggregator, sending-capacity & warmup planner, FastAPI POST /v1/preflight + /v1/capacity and n8n workflow done (246 offline tests); live DNS adapter and README polish left before v0.1.0.
Hiring/funding/expansion/tech-change/site-visit signals as evidence-backed events with priority rules.
Waterfall enrichment with provenance and cost budget, email verification, CRM dedupe.
Research + first lines: generator -> reviewer -> deterministic QA, JSON schema, citation guard, evals.
Instantly / Smartlead / HeyReach adapters, custom variables, suppression, idempotent pushes.
Reply intent classification (interested, objection, referral, OOO+return date, unsubscribe, bounce) and routing.
HubSpot / Pipedrive / Attio upsert, lifecycle stages, assignment rules, field-level ownership.
n8n error workflow, retries/backoff, idempotency keys, DLQ service, alerts.
Funnel by segment/signal from raw events with reconciliation; A/B significance.
docker-compose n8n + services + Postgres, full synthetic run, live n8n import test.
Learn ICP and signal weights from won/lost.
MCP server exposing score, enrich, preflight, classify to AI agents.

02: SPF parser + worst-case lookup/void-lookup budget checker (RFC 7208)

02: DKIM selector key-record check (RFC 6376 §3.6, RFC 8301 key length/sha256, RFC 8463 Ed25519)
02: complaint-rate guardrail (0.1% target / 0.3% limit, small-sample handling) + preflight() aggregator with pass/review/block verdict
02: FastAPI POST /v1/preflight (fixture-backed demo resolver) + examples on .example domains
02: n8n 'preflight before send' workflow (Switch on verdict), structure-tested

02: content lint (unrendered merge tags, IP/shortener/http links, link-text vs href mismatch, unbranded tracking domain, HTML-only, image-heavy/hidden content, subject/phrase heuristics) wired into preflight() and the API

02: sending-capacity & warmup planner (plan_capacity: warmup -> ramp -> cap per mailbox, complaint hold/pause, per-domain totals, target date, extra mailboxes/domains, provider-ceiling check) + POST /v1/capacity

02: DKIM-Signature header check (required tags, v=1, rsa-sha1/unknown a=, From in h=, i= within d=, c=, t=/x= expiry, l= warning); preflight() checks each signature's own d=/s= key and excludes broken signatures from alignment

02: DMARCbis DNS Tree Walk (draft-ietf-dmarc-dmarcbis-41 §4.10): discovery up to the TLD, max 8 queries, psd=y/n stop, policy from author -> org domain -> PSD, duplicate records skipped; tree_walk_org_domain / TreeWalkOrgDomain for alignment; DMARC_PSD_POLICY_ONLY
02: PublicSuffixList (official .dat format: wildcards, exceptions, implicit *, ICANN/PRIVATE sections, IDN A-labels) with .org_domain for alignment and content lint

02: DMARCbis policy rules (draft-41 §4.7, §4.10.1, App. A.6): t=y steps policy down one level (requested_policy vs effective_policy), pct reported as historic, np for non-existent subdomains (author_domain_exists, DMARC_NP_IF_NXDOMAIN), invalid/missing p or invalid sp/np -> p=none with a valid rua, else no DMARC

known_gaps: 01 n8n workflow is structure-tested only; never imported into a live n8n instance.
02: no live DNS adapter; all checks verified only against FakeResolver.

Run environment: bare `pytest` on PATH is an isolated uv tool without project deps, and bare `pip` installs into the system Python, not /usr/local/bin/python; use `python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"` and `python -m pytest`.
01 weights are hand-set; no calibration on real won/lost data yet (project 12).

02: provider bulk-sender thresholds (Gmail/Yahoo/Microsoft, 0.1%/0.3% complaint rate) taken from web-search summaries of third-party pages; primary pages unreachable from the run environment (2026-10-10, 2026-10-12).

02: RFC 6376/8301/8463 rules (DKIM key records and, since 2026-10-15, DKIM-Signature tags) implemented from knowledge plus search summaries; RFC pages and the IANA DKIM registry were blocked or unresolvable from the run environment (403 / ENOTFOUND).
02: DKIM check reads published keys only; no signature verification, no private/public key match check.
02: n8n preflight workflow never imported into a live n8n instance; API tested only with TestClient and fixture DNS.

02: content-lint rules (shorteners, spam phrases, 3-link limit, image/text ratio) are heuristics from knowledge plus a vendor-blog search summary; no provider publishes its filters and no provider page could be opened (2026-10-14).

02: capacity-planner defaults (14-day warmup, ramp 5 + 2/day, 30/mailbox/day, 3 mailboxes/domain) and provider ceilings (Google Workspace 2,000 msgs/user/day, Exchange Online 10,000 recipients/day; a reported 2,000 external-recipient Exchange limit was not modelled because its date conflicts between sources) come from web-search summaries only; knowledge.workspace.google.com, learn.microsoft.com and prospeo.io gave ENOTFOUND (2026-10-14).
02: default org_domain is still last-two-labels; PSL (PublicSuffixList) and tree walk (TreeWalkOrgDomain) are opt-in, the API uses neither, and no PSL is bundled.

02: DMARCbis rules (tree walk, psd, t, np, invalid-p fallback, pct historic) implemented from draft-ietf-dmarc-dmarcbis-41 (April 2025, IETF DMARC WG GitHub repo); whether the published RFC (reported RFC 9989) changed them is unverified (rfc-editor.org, datatracker.ietf.org: proxy 403 on 2026-10-16, twice). np needs the caller to say the Author Domain does not exist: the Resolver cannot tell NXDOMAIN from no-TXT.

02: PSL matching rules (wildcard, exception, implicit '*') implemented from knowledge of publicsuffix.org/list; that page was unreachable (ENOTFOUND), only the .dat file itself was opened via its GitHub mirror.
